overview: Provides an in-depth understanding of operating system principles including process management, threads, CPU scheduling algorithms, inter-process communication, deadlocks, virtual memory management, file systems, and storage allocation.

units.title: Introduction to Operating Systems & System Structures
units.topics: Operating system overview, dual-mode operation, system calls, OS structures (Monolithic, Layered, Microkernel, Hybrid), virtual machines, boot process.

units.title: Process Management, Threads & CPU Scheduling
units.topics: Process control block (PCB), process state transitions, context switching, inter-process communication (Pipes, Shared Memory, Message Queues). Multithreading models. Scheduling criteria, algorithms (FCFS, SJF, SRTF, Priority, Round Robin, Multi-Level Queue).

units.title: Process Synchronization & Deadlocks
units.topics: Critical section problem, Peterson's algorithm, hardware synchronization, Semaphores, Monitors, Classical synchronization problems (Dining Philosophers, Producer-Consumer, Readers-Writers). Deadlock characterization, prevention, avoidance (Banker's Algorithm), detection and recovery.

units.title: Memory Management & Virtual Memory
units.topics: Contiguous memory allocation, Paging, Segmentation, Hierarchical paging. Virtual memory: Demand paging, Page replacement algorithms (FIFO, Optimal, LRU, LFU), Thrashing, Working set model.

units.title: Storage Management & File Systems
units.topics: File concepts, access methods, directory structures, file allocation methods (Contiguous, Linked, Indexed), free-space management. Disk structure, disk scheduling (FCFS, SSTF, SCAN, C-SCAN, LOOK), RAID architectures.

textbooks: Abraham Silberschatz, Peter Baer Galvin, Greg Gagne, 'Operating System Concepts', 10th Edition, Wiley, 2018.
Andrew S. Tanenbaum, Herbert Bos, 'Modern Operating Systems', 4th Edition, Pearson, 2015.
referenceBooks: William Stallings, 'Operating Systems: Internals and Design Principles', 9th Edition, Pearson, 2018.

overview: Fundamental data structures and algorithm design techniques. Stacks, queues, linked lists, binary search trees, AVL trees, B-Trees, heaps, graph traversals (BFS, DFS), sorting and searching algorithms.

units.title: Linear Data Structures
units.topics: Abstract Data Types (ADTs), Arrays, Singly linked list, Doubly linked list, Circular linked list, Applications of linked lists (Polynomial addition).

units.title: Stacks and Queues
units.topics: Stack operations, Infix to Postfix conversion, Evaluation of postfix expressions. Queue operations, Circular queue, Priority queue, Deque.

units.title: Non-Linear Data Structures: Trees
units.topics: Binary Trees, Binary Search Trees (BST), AVL Trees, Red-Black Trees, B-Trees, B+ Trees, Heaps and Heap Sort.

units.title: Graphs and Traversals
units.topics: Graph representations (Adjacency matrix, Adjacency list), Breadth First Search (BFS), Depth First Search (DFS), Topological Sorting, Minimum Spanning Trees (Prim's, Kruskal's), Shortest Path (Dijkstra's Algorithm).

units.title: Hashing and Algorithm Analysis
units.topics: Hash functions, Collision resolution techniques (Chaining, Open Addressing), Asymptotic notations (Big O, Omega, Theta), Sorting algorithms (Quick Sort, Merge Sort, Radix Sort).

textbooks: Mark Allen Weiss, 'Data Structures and Algorithm Analysis in C++', 4th Edition, Pearson, 2014.
Ellis Horowitz, Sartaj Sahni, Susan Anderson-Freed, 'Fundamentals of Data Structures in C', 2nd Edition, Silicon Press, 2008.
referenceBooks: Thomas H. Cormen, Charles E. Leiserson, Ronald L. Rivest, Clifford Stein, 'Introduction to Algorithms', 3rd Edition, MIT Press, 2009.

overview: Entity-Relationship modeling, relational algebra, SQL queries, normalization (1NF, 2NF, 3NF, BCNF), transaction processing, concurrency control, and NoSQL databases.

units.title: Introduction to Databases & ER Model
units.topics: Database system architecture, data models, Entity-Relationship (ER) diagram, Extended ER features, Relational data model concepts and constraints.

units.title: Relational Algebra & SQL
units.topics: Relational algebra operations, DDL, DML, DCL commands, complex SQL queries, nested queries, aggregate functions, views, triggers, and stored procedures.

units.title: Database Design & Normalization
units.topics: Functional dependencies, inference rules, decomposition, Normal forms: 1NF, 2NF, 3NF, Boyce-Codd Normal Form (BCNF), multi-valued dependencies and 4NF.

units.title: Transactions & Concurrency Control
units.topics: ACID properties, serializability, lock-based protocols (2-Phase Locking), timestamp ordering, deadlock handling in databases, recovery systems and write-ahead logging (WAL).

units.title: Indexing, Query Optimization & NoSQL
units.topics: File organization, B+ tree indexing, query processing and optimization strategies. Overview of NoSQL databases: MongoDB document stores, key-value stores.

textbooks: Raghu Ramakrishnan, Johannes Gehrke, 'Database Management Systems', 3rd Edition, McGraw-Hill, 2014.
Ramez Elmasri, Shamkant B. Navathe, 'Fundamentals of Database Systems', 7th Edition, Pearson, 2017.
referenceBooks: Silberschatz, Korth, Sudarshan, 'Database System Concepts', 7th Edition, McGraw-Hill, 2019.

overview: Covers intelligent agents, heuristic search, adversarial game playing, supervised learning (regression, classification, SVM), unsupervised clustering (K-Means, PCA), neural networks, and deep learning basics.

units.title: Introduction to AI & Problem Solving
units.topics: Agents and environments, state space representation, uninformed search (BFS, DFS, Uniform Cost), informed search (A* Search, Greedy Best First), heuristic evaluation functions.

units.title: Adversarial Search & Knowledge Representation
units.topics: Game playing, Minimax algorithm, Alpha-Beta pruning. Propositional logic, first-order predicate logic, resolution refutation, ontology and semantic networks.

units.title: Supervised Learning
units.topics: Linear regression, logistic regression, decision trees, random forests, Naive Bayes classifier, Support Vector Machines (SVM), evaluation metrics (Precision, Recall, F1-Score, ROC-AUC).

units.title: Unsupervised Learning & Dimensionality Reduction
units.topics: K-Means clustering, Hierarchical clustering, Expectation-Maximization, Principal Component Analysis (PCA), Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA).

units.title: Neural Networks & Modern AI Trends
units.topics: Perceptron, Multilayer Perceptron (MLP), Backpropagation algorithm, Introduction to Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN), overview of Generative AI.

textbooks: Stuart Russell, Peter Norvig, 'Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach', 4th Edition, Pearson, 2020.
referenceBooks: Christopher Bishop, 'Pattern Recognition and Machine Learning', Springer, 2006.

overview: Discrete-time signals and systems, Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT), Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) algorithms, design of Infinite Impulse Response (IIR) and Finite Impulse Response (FIR) digital filters, finite word length effects.

units.title: Discrete Fourier Transform & FFT
units.topics: Review of DTFT, Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT), properties of DFT, circular convolution. Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) algorithms: Radix-2 Decimation-in-Time (DIT) and Decimation-in-Frequency (DIF) algorithms.

units.title: IIR Filter Design
units.topics: Analog filter approximations (Butterworth, Chebyshev), transformation of analog filters to digital filters: Bilinear Transformation, Impulse Invariance method, frequency warping.

units.title: FIR Filter Design
units.topics: Linear phase characteristics of FIR filters, windowing techniques (Rectangular, Hamming, Hanning, Blackman), frequency sampling design method, comparison of IIR and FIR filters.

units.title: Finite Word Length Effects
units.topics: Fixed point and floating point number representations, ADC quantization noise, coefficient quantization error, limit cycle oscillations, deadband effect.

units.title: Multirate Signal Processing & DSP Processors
units.topics: Decimation, interpolation, sampling rate conversion, polyphase decomposition. Architecture of TMS320C6x DSP processor, MAC unit, pipelining.

textbooks: John G. Proakis, Dimitris G. Manolakis, 'Digital Signal Processing: Principles, Algorithms and Applications', 4th Edition, Pearson, 2007.
Alan V. Oppenheim, Ronald W. Schafer, 'Discrete-Time Signal Processing', 3rd Edition, Prentice Hall, 2009.
referenceBooks: Sanjit K. Mitra, 'Digital Signal Processing: A Computer-Based Approach', 4th Edition, McGraw-Hill, 2011.

overview: 8086 microprocessor architecture, assembly language programming, memory interfacing, 8051 microcontroller architecture, peripheral interfacing (timers, serial communication, DAC, ADC, stepper motor).

units.title: 8086 Microprocessor Architecture
units.topics: Architecture of 8086, Bus Interface Unit (BIU), Execution Unit (EU), register organization, memory segmentation, pin diagram, minimum and maximum mode operations, interrupt structure.

units.title: 8086 Assembly Language Programming
units.topics: Addressing modes, instruction set (data transfer, arithmetic, logical, string, branch), assembler directives, assembly code for arithmetic and array operations, procedures and macros.

units.title: Peripheral Interfacing with 8086
units.topics: 8255 Programmable Peripheral Interface (PPI), 8254/8253 Programmable Interval Timer, 8259 Priority Interrupt Controller, 8251 USART, interfacing ADC and DAC.

units.title: 8051 Microcontroller Architecture
units.topics: Comparison of microprocessor and microcontroller, 8051 block diagram, pin configuration, memory organization (internal RAM/ROM), Special Function Registers (SFRs), I/O ports, timers and counters.

units.title: 8051 Interfacing & Embedded Applications
units.topics: 8051 interrupts, serial communication programming (RS232), interfacing LCD display, matrix keyboard, stepper motor, and relay to 8051.

textbooks: A. K. Ray, K. M. Bhurchandi, 'Advanced Microprocessors and Peripherals', 3rd Edition, McGraw-Hill, 2012.
Muhammad Ali Mazidi, Janice Gillispie Mazidi, Rolin D. McKinlay, 'The 8051 Microcontroller and Embedded Systems', 2nd Edition, Pearson, 2007.
referenceBooks: Douglas V. Hall, 'Microprocessors and Interfacing', McGraw-Hill, 2005.
